body_markdown:
Product loss during shipment rarely comes down to one bad decision. It’s usually a combination: a package that wasn’t suited to the product, a closure that wasn’t fit for the application, or transportation and handling conditions that weren’t fully accounted for.


Every product brings its own requirements, and with a corrosive chemical, the container isn’t just holding the product, it’s actively resisting it. Aggressive solvents can slowly break down certain plastics from the inside, showing up as stress cracking or swelling long before a leak becomes visible.


Chlorides and other aggressive components can pit or corrode metal surfaces the same way. That’s why compatibility, not just container strength, can drive decisions on resin type or barrier layers.


A bulk liquid moving through automated filling lines runs into a different problem entirely, one built around consistent handling rather than chemical attack. That’s why Greif offers steel drums, plastic drums, jerrycans, and GCUBE® IBCs with distinct customizations, each built for a different set of requirements.


Some products need more than the container alone can offer. Oxygen exposure can quietly degrade a sensitive chemical or agrochemical long before it reaches its destination. That’s where barrier technologies like EcoEx®, SiOx, and In-Mold Barrier (IMB) come in, helping preserve product integrity across the supply chain.


Then there’s the trip itself. Long hauls, temperature swings, vibration, and repeated handling all put pressure on packaging that looks fine sitting in a warehouse. And even the sturdiest container can fail if the closure isn’t right for the job, which is why Tri-Sure® focuses on matching container and closure as one system rather than two separate decisions.


The common thread across all of it: When packaging decisions are driven by performance needs, costly corrections further down the line become far less likely.


Ready to evaluate your options? Connect with a Greif expert and we’ll help you find a packaging and closure solution designed to protect your product from filling line to final destination.
